prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A single right-pointing arrowhead followed by a thin vertical bar to
its right, in dark ink. "Advance one frame" feel.

formatted_prompt.scene: Ink and watercolor archival plate on aged vellum cream parchment, a right-pointing solid arrowhead beside a thin vertical bar, rendered in dense slate ink with warm ember accent at the arrowhead tip.

subjects.description: Bold filled triangular arrowhead pointing right, crisp nib-pen edges, compact and weighty, flush with a thin vertical rule to its right.
Thin upright rectangular bar, same height as arrowhead, firm ink stroke, clean terminals top and bottom.
